text:
Ava: Quick check 1: projector or big TV for Friday mini-LAN? Projector makes everything feel cinematic but setup is a pain.
Marcus: Projector if someone can bring a case. I have spare surge protector.
Chen: TV for Smash and platformers. No keystone battles. Also we can wall-mount the TV if needed.
Priya: If projector, can we angle it toward the mezzanine instead of the whiteboard? less glare.
Ava: Good call @Priya. Also anyone bringing an extra ethernet cable? WiFi can get flaky with a dozen devices.
Marcus: Ive got a 10m Cat6 to lend. Will drop it by Friday morning.
Chen: Bringing Steam Deck and a Switch dock. Happy to host TowerFall and local co-op Celeste.
Priya: I'll bring two Xbox pads + adapter. Also snacks: homemade trail mix unless someone allergic to peanuts?
Ava: Peanut-free please (weve got a teammate with allergy). Chips and soda backup also welcome.
DiceBot: Prize alert! 1x random Steam key to the winner of the Smash mini-tourney. Use `!join` to enter bracket.
Marcus: Oh nice. What's the bracket format?
Ava: 1v1 double-elim, best-of-3 until finals. Cap at 12 entrants so we can wrap by 9:30.
Chen: Can we also do a casual co-op speedrun table for indie games? No bracket, just chill.
Priya: Love that. I'll run a signup sheet on Friday with game slots (Smash, TowerFall, Indie Co-op, Free Play).
Ava: Logistics: meetup 6pm, setup volunteers at 5:30 (cc @Marcus). Building security: reminder to badge out if youre staying late.
Marcus: I can help move gear at 5:30. Also projector case is in my car.
Chen: Remote folks: DiceBot created lobby `LAN-Fri-99`. Parsec link: `parsec://connect?host=10.9.8.7`.
Priya: Anyone up for a low-key cosplay of characters? kidding but I might bring a tiny foam sword :wink: 
Ava: RSVP: Ava, Marcus, Chen, Priya, Sam (maybe), Jordan (late). See yall Friday :partyparrot:
